+# FE-BASE 独立前端基线
+
+任务来源为 Issue #3，dsh Ticket `914d2ac32b5d2f130d718138164c8bab`。范围与独立预期见 [冻结记录](../evidence/FE-BASE/criteria.md)。本入口运行完整 turbine-explorer 源程序。
+
+## 来源和许可
+
+- 原始仓库：`https://github.com/AlexZhangji/turbine-explorer.git`。
+- 固定 commit：`efc5d2ecd12055f880a41b47215791c22d3656d4`；Git tree：`03487ef57f6bc957dfc83b890de1f1e700ed2841`。
+- 完整参考克隆：`/home/lsy/workspace/lab/_upstream/turbine-explorer`。
+- 实际导入：`git subtree add --prefix=vendor/turbine-explorer /home/lsy/workspace/lab/_upstream/turbine-explorer efc5d2ecd12055f880a41b47215791c22d3656d4 --squash`。
+- 导入提交：`459a359afd4e2e2bdaca05acccc4b65f79b741d8`；压缩历史提交：`8053436d63df1790eaf0a6011de34d1143cd5e1a`，保存原始 subtree trailers；导入 tree 与上游相同。
+- 完整62项文件及哈希：[来源清单](../evidence/FE-BASE/upstream-manifest.json)。
+- 原作者代码、程序几何 MIT：[LICENSE](../vendor/turbine-explorer/LICENSE)；[第三方说明](../vendor/turbine-explorer/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)；[HDR 来源](../vendor/turbine-explorer/public/environment/README.md)；[Manrope OFL](../vendor/turbine-explorer/public/fonts/Manrope-OFL.txt)、[Space Grotesk OFL](../vendor/turbine-explorer/public/fonts/SpaceGrotesk-OFL.txt)、[Three.js MIT](../vendor/turbine-explorer/licenses/three-LICENSE.txt) 均随完整源树保留。
+
+模型、路径和流动具有教学性质，原作者的额定功率与教学计算保持原有含义。范围及限制见 [上游技术来源](../vendor/turbine-explorer/docs/SOURCES.md)。
+
+本地兼容补丁仅涉及 [component-inspector.ts](../vendor/turbine-explorer/src/component-inspector.ts)：选择组件、滑块输入、拖动及抽出/归位按钮将百分比写入 `.lab-assembly-tools output`。实际产品版本为完整固定源码加该补丁；原版文件哈希、候选文件哈希及完整 unified diff 分别保存于验收 `source.json` 和 `upstream.patch`，原版浏览器失败记录独立保留。
+
+## 独立运行
+
+在 `vendor/turbine-explorer` 内执行原始命令：
+
+```sh
+npm ci
+npm test
+npm run build
+npm run preview -- --port 4173 --strictPort
+```
+
+访问本机 `http://127.0.0.1:4173/?lang=en&quality=balanced&experience=console&speed=0`。源程序直接创建 Three.js 程序几何和原有控件。已有 GLB 作为独立资产保留。原始 `npm run build:labs` 也列入基线检查，产物只在本机核查。
+
+上游要求 Node >=22.18.0；本次环境 Node v24.22.2/npm 11.19.1。全部上游依赖采用原始锁文件；自有浏览器工具独立锁定 Playwright1.56.1。
+
+## 准确候选验收
+
+已安装真实 Chrome for Testing156.0.8078.80。主机缺少的实际共享库通过 Ubuntu apt 包提供至本任务 `.scratch-runtime/browser-deps`。对应依赖包、失败及环境记录在验收证据中保存。独立复验可使用正常系统安装的相同依赖；本机执行环境为：
+
+```sh
+export FE_BASE_CHROME=/home/lsy/.agent-browser/browsers/chrome-156.0.8078.80/chrome
+export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$PWD/.scratch-runtime/browser-deps/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu"
+export TMPDIR=/home/lsy/.fe914tmp
+export TMP="$TMPDIR"
+export TEMP="$TMPDIR"
+python3 scripts/verify_fe_base.py --criteria 7704387252b293bee1ec671b440164a12287ca16 --candidate <C完整SHA> --output .scratch-runtime/fe-base-<C完整SHA>
+```
+

+
+冻结S、原始独立FAIL及两个原始SHA256保持。反馈命令已实际运行：node .scratch-runtime/zoom-diagnosis/repro.mjs <新JSON> 3，真实完整程序只执行主场景镜头段，三轮均PASS。删除后续组件/HDR步骤缩短反馈路径；完整程序的实际GPU和控件保留。不能据这三轮成功替代独立FAIL。该真实软件渲染路径每轮约两分钟，未缩减真实模型或冻结viewport以取得更快结果。
+
+1. 镜头拖动余下运动与滚轮异步处理发生交错：若缩放条件在滚轮到达前就因距原点变化而满足，则第一阶段采样时对应真实wheel事件尚不存在，且后续反向wheel恢复后的距离可能小于错误采样。只改变真实drag的steps数量，检查条件成立时的实际事件序号；预期较少steps提高该现象出现率。
+2. 实际wheel命中点改变或事件延后处理：若缩放输入到达其他DOM元素或尚未到达canvas，则失败记录的isTrusted/target/坐标/真实deltaY及事件时间会直接显示该差异。仅补充只读事件观测，不改变事件处理。
+3. GPU观察选择或采样时刻陈旧：若main[0]含旧viewMatrix，则事件之后的draw和矩阵上传序号、program与实际projection应显示新旧不一致；只读记录上传/绘制来源及真实帧边界。
+4. 若前三项证据均不成立，再检查软件渲染下条件回调与GPU帧间隔是否耗尽冻结120秒；不会通过延长超时或降低阈值处理。
+
+每个变量单独试验。不得更改相机、控制器状态、GPU结果或测试预期。最终整改须重新运行原完整入口、五条必要验收、干净检出及对应独立审查。镜头所有步骤及失败现场记录作为已确认Standards缺项，在同一新候选补齐。

+export function cameraChangedAfterInput({selector, reference, operation}) {
+  const value = window.__feBaseObserve(selector);
+  const matrix = value?.main[0]?.matrix;
+  if (!matrix) return false;
+  if (operation === 'rotate') {
+    return [0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10].some(index => Math.abs(matrix[index] - reference[index]) > 1e-5);
+  }
+  const current = Math.hypot(...matrix.slice(12, 15));
+  const previous = Math.hypot(...reference.slice(12, 15));
+  if (operation === 'zoom-in') return current < previous - .01;
+  if (operation === 'zoom-out') return current > previous + .01;
+  throw new Error('未知镜头操作');
+}

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import {writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
+import {chromium} from '../../scripts/fe-base/node_modules/playwright/index.mjs';
+
+const [output, rounds = '3', dragSteps = '12'] = process.argv.slice(2);
+assert(output);
+const report = {candidate: 'e77466c3390b6c8b05f52d5b5a4bd00fc77b291c', rounds: [], startedAt: new Date().toISOString()};
+const save = () => writeFileSync(output, JSON.stringify(report, null, 2) + '\n');
+const browser = await chromium.launch({executablePath: process.env.FE_BASE_CHROME, headless: true,
+  args: ['--no-sandbox', '--use-angle=swiftshader', '--enable-unsafe-swiftshader']});
+try {
+  for (let round = 0; round < Number(rounds); round++) {
+    const context = await browser.newContext({viewport: {width: 1920, height: 1080}, deviceScaleFactor: 1,
+      locale: 'en-US', timezoneId: 'Asia/Shanghai', reducedMotion: 'reduce'});
+    await context.addInitScript({path: new URL('../../scripts/fe-base/observe-webgl.js', import.meta.url).pathname});
+    await context.addInitScript(() => {
+      window.__zoomTrace = {events: [], samples: []};
+      for (const type of ['wheel', 'pointerdown', 'pointerup']) document.addEventListener(type, event => {
+        const data = {type, at: performance.now(), trusted: event.isTrusted, target: event.target.id || event.target.className,
+          x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY, deltaY: event.deltaY, deltaMode: event.deltaMode, defaultPrevented: event.defaultPrevented};
+        window.__zoomTrace.events.push(data);
+        queueMicrotask(() => { data.preventedAfter = event.defaultPrevented; });
+      }, {capture: true, passive: true});
+      function sample(at) {
+        const data = window.__feBaseObserve('#scene');
+        if (data?.main.length) {
+          window.__zoomTrace.samples.push({at, draws: data.draws,
+            main: data.main.slice(0, 3), distance: Math.hypot(...data.main[0].matrix.slice(12, 15))});
+          if (window.__zoomTrace.samples.length > 120) window.__zoomTrace.samples.shift();
+        }
+        requestAnimationFrame(sample);
+      }
+      requestAnimationFrame(sample);
+    });
+    const page = await context.newPage();
+    page.setDefaultTimeout(120000);
+    const result = {round, steps: [], errors: []};
+    report.rounds.push(result);
+    page.on('pageerror', error => { result.errors.push(error.message); save(); });
+    const observe = () => page.evaluate(() => ({...window.__feBaseObserve('#scene'), events: window.__zoomTrace.events.slice()}));
+    const matrix = async name => {
+      const value = await observe();
+      assert(value.main.length > 0);
+      const matrix = value.main[0].matrix;
+      result.steps.push({name, at: new Date().toISOString(), draws: value.draws, matrix,
+        program: value.main[0].id, events: value.events, distance: Math.hypot(...matrix.slice(12, 15))});
+      save();
+      return matrix;
+    };
+    try {
+      await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:4173/?lang=en&quality=balanced&experience=console&speed=0');
+      await page.waitForFunction(() => {
+        const value = window.__feBaseObserve('#scene');
+        return value?.draws > 0 && value.frameDraws.length >= 3
+          && value.frameDraws.slice(-3).every(count => count === value.frameDraws.at(-1));
+      });
+      const before = await matrix('before');
+      await page.waitForFunction(previous => {
+        const value = window.__feBaseObserve('#scene');
+        return value.draws > previous && value.frameDraws.length >= 3
+          && value.frameDraws.slice(-3).every(count => count === value.frameDraws.at(-1));
+      }, (await observe()).draws);
+      await matrix('still');
+      const box = await page.locator('#scene').boundingBox();
+      const input = {x: box.x + box.width * .55, y: box.y + box.height * .52, dx: 160, dy: 80};
+      result.input = input;
+      assert(await page.locator('#scene').evaluate((canvas, point) => document.elementFromPoint(point.x, point.y) === canvas, input));
+      await page.mouse.move(input.x, input.y);
+      await page.mouse.down();
+      await page.mouse.move(input.x + input.dx, input.y + input.dy, {steps: Number(dragSteps)});
+      await page.mouse.up();
+      await page.waitForFunction(before => {
+        const m = window.__feBaseObserve('#scene')?.main[0]?.matrix;
+        return m && [0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10].some(i => Math.abs(m[i] - before[i]) > 1e-5);
+      }, before);
+      const rotated = await matrix('rotated');
+      await page.mouse.move(input.x, input.y);
+      await page.mouse.wheel(0, -600);
+      await page.waitForFunction(previous => {
+        const m = window.__feBaseObserve('#scene')?.main[0]?.matrix;
+        return m && Math.hypot(...m.slice(12, 15)) < previous - .01;
+      }, Math.hypot(...rotated.slice(12, 15)));
+      const zoomed = await matrix('zoomed');
+      await page.mouse.wheel(0, 600);
+      await page.waitForFunction(previous => {
+        const m = window.__feBaseObserve('#scene')?.main[0]?.matrix;
+        return m && Math.hypot(...m.slice(12, 15)) > previous + .01;
+      }, Math.hypot(...zoomed.slice(12, 15)));
+      await matrix('restored');
+      result.state = 'PASS';
+    } catch (error) {
+      result.state = 'FAIL';
+      result.failure = {name: error.name, message: error.message};
+      throw error;
+    } finally {
+      result.trace = await page.evaluate(() => window.__zoomTrace);
+      result.finishedAt = new Date().toISOString();
+      save();
+      await context.close();
+    }
+  }
+  report.state = 'PASS';
+} finally {
+  report.finishedAt = new Date().toISOString();
+  save();
+  await browser.close();
+}

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { chromium } from 'playwright';
+import { cameraChangedAfterInput } from './camera-observation.mjs';
+
+const [baseUrl, output] = process.argv.slice(2);
+assert(baseUrl && output, '需要 URL 和输出路径');
+const report = {baseUrl, startedAt: new Date().toISOString(), operations: [], network: [], console: [], errors: []};
+const save = () => writeFileSync(output, JSON.stringify(report, null, 2) + '\n');
+const record = (name, data) => { report.operations.push({name, at: new Date().toISOString(), ...data}); save(); };
+const executablePath = process.env.FE_BASE_CHROME;
+assert(executablePath, '必须明确 FE_BASE_CHROME');
+const args = ['--no-sandbox', '--use-angle=swiftshader', '--enable-unsafe-swiftshader'];
+const browser = await chromium.launch({executablePath, headless: true, args});
+try {
+  report.environment = {version: browser.version(), executablePath, args, viewport: {width: 1920, height: 1080}, deviceScaleFactor: 1};
+  assert.equal(browser.version(), '156.0.8078.80');
+  const context = await browser.newContext({viewport: report.environment.viewport, deviceScaleFactor: 1,
+    locale: 'en-US', timezoneId: 'Asia/Shanghai', reducedMotion: 'reduce'});
+  await context.addInitScript({path: new URL('./observe-webgl.js', import.meta.url).pathname});
+  const page = await context.newPage();
+  page.setDefaultTimeout(120000);
+  page.setDefaultNavigationTimeout(120000);
+  let rejectFailure;
+  const failure = new Promise((resolve, reject) => { rejectFailure = reject; });
+  // 提前附加处理，导航期间的异步错误由统一流程立即终止并回收浏览器。
+  failure.catch(() => {});
+  const fail = data => { report.errors.push(data); save(); rejectFailure(new Error(JSON.stringify(data))); };
+  page.on('console', message => {
+    const data = {type: message.type(), text: message.text()};
+    report.console.push(data); save();
+    if (data.type === 'error' || /failed to load|context lost|shader error/i.test(data.text)) fail(data);
+  });
+  page.on('pageerror', error => fail({type: 'pageerror', message: error.message}));
+  page.on('requestfailed', request => fail({type: 'requestfailed', url: request.url(), failure: request.failure()}));
+  page.on('response', response => {
+    const data = {url: response.url(), status: response.status(), type: response.request().resourceType()};
+    report.network.push(data); save();
+    if (data.status >= 400) fail({type: 'http-error', ...data});
+  });
+  const observe = selector => page.evaluate(selector => window.__feBaseObserve(selector), selector);
+  const rendered = async (selector, previous = 0) => {
+    await page.waitForFunction(({selector, previous}) => {
+      const value = window.__feBaseObserve(selector);
+      return value && value.draws > previous && value.frameDraws.length >= 3
+        && value.frameDraws.slice(-3).every(count => count === value.frameDraws.at(-1));
+    }, {selector, previous});
+    return observe(selector);
+  };
+  const distance = value => Math.hypot(...value.slice(12, 15));
+  const rotationDelta = (a, b) => Math.max(...[0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10].map(index => Math.abs(a[index] - b[index])));
+  async function interact(selector) {
+    const operation = {name: 'camera-' + selector, selector, state: 'RUNNING', checkpoints: []};
+    report.operations.push(operation); save();
+    const checkpoint = async phase => {
+      operation.phase = phase;
+      const observation = await observe(selector);
+      operation.checkpoints.push({phase, at: new Date().toISOString(), observation});
+      save();

+export function cameraChangedAfterInput({selector, reference, operation, afterInput}) {
+  if (!Number.isInteger(afterInput)) throw new Error('需要操作前的实际输入序号');
+  if (!['rotate', 'zoom-in', 'zoom-out'].includes(operation)) throw new Error('未知镜头操作');
+  const value = window.__feBaseObserve(selector);
+  const camera = value?.main[0];
+  if (!camera) return false;
+  const input = value.inputEvents.findLast(event => event.sequence > afterInput
+    && event.canvasId === value.canvasId && event.trusted && event.completed
+    && (operation === 'rotate' ? event.type === 'pointermove' && event.buttons === 1
+      : event.type === 'wheel' && event.deltaY === (operation === 'zoom-in' ? -600 : 600)
+        && event.defaultPrevented));
+  if (!input || !(camera.viewUpload > input.viewUploadsAtInput
+    && camera.lastDraw > input.drawsAtInput && camera.lastDraw > camera.viewUploadedAtDraw)) return false;
+  const matrix = camera.matrix;
+  if (operation === 'rotate') {
+    return [0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10].some(index => Math.abs(matrix[index] - reference[index]) > 1e-5);
+  }
+  const current = Math.hypot(...matrix.slice(12, 15));
+  const previous = Math.hypot(...reference.slice(12, 15));
+  if (operation === 'zoom-in') return current < previous - .01;
+  if (operation === 'zoom-out') return current > previous + .01;
+  throw new Error('未知镜头操作');
+}

+  let nextCanvas = 0;
+  let nextInput = 0;
+  const inputEvents = [];

+    }

+    document.addEventListener(type, event => {

+        target: event.target.id || event.target.tagName, canvasId: canvas?.canvasId,

+      draws: data.draws, viewUploads: data.viewUploads, frameDraws: data.frameDraws.slice(),

+        viewUploadedAtDraw: value.viewUploadedAtDraw, lastDraw: value.lastDraw}))};

+    if (!data) throw new Error('缺少真实 GPU 观察数据');

+import argparse
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import tarfile
+import time
+import urllib.error
+import urllib.request
+
+BASE = '86e521184a4d5bbd42dfe93a48999fa714c233f2'
+IMPORT = '459a359afd4e2e2bdaca05acccc4b65f79b741d8'
+UPSTREAM = 'efc5d2ecd12055f880a41b47215791c22d3656d4'
+TREE = '03487ef57f6bc957dfc83b890de1f1e700ed2841'
+ORIGIN = 'https://github.com/shuyu-lin-dev/gas-turbine-lifecycle-lab.git'
+S = '7704387252b293bee1ec671b440164a12287ca16'
+
+
+def sha(data):
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+
+
+class Run:
+    def __init__(self, root, output):
+        self.root = root
+        self.output = output
+        self.commands = []
+        self.env = dict(os.environ)
+        assert self.env.get('TMPDIR') and Path(self.env['TMPDIR']).resolve().is_relative_to(root / '.scratch-runtime')
+        assert self.env.get('FE_BASE_CHROME'), '需要 FE_BASE_CHROME'
+
+    def save(self, name, value):
+        (self.output / name).write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
+
+    def run(self, argv, cwd=None, timeout=120, expected=0):
+        cwd = cwd or self.root
+        record = {'argv': [str(value) for value in argv], 'cwd': str(cwd),
+                  'at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'exit_code': None}
+        self.commands.append(record)
+        self.save('commands.json', self.commands)
+        try:
+            result = subprocess.run(record['argv'], cwd=cwd, env=self.env, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout)
+            record.update(exit_code=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout.decode(), stderr=result.stderr.decode(),
+                          stdout_sha256=sha(result.stdout), stderr_sha256=sha(result.stderr))
+            assert result.returncode == expected, f'命令退出{result.returncode}: {argv}'
+            return result.stdout.decode().strip()
+        finally:
+            self.save('commands.json', self.commands)
+
+    def git(self, *args, cwd=None):
+        return self.run(['git', *args], cwd=cwd)
+
+    def baseline(self, directory, prefix):
+        for name, command in [('install', ['npm', 'ci']), ('test', ['npm', 'test']),
+                              ('build', ['npm', 'run', 'build']), ('build-labs', ['npm', 'run', 'build:labs'])]:
+            self.run(command, cwd=directory, timeout=600)
+        dependencies = json.loads(self.run(['npm', 'ls', '--all', '--json'], cwd=directory))
+        self.save(prefix + '-dependencies.json', dependencies)
+        lock = json.loads((directory / 'package-lock.json').read_text())
+        packages = []
+        for name, metadata in lock['packages'].items():
+            if not name:
+                continue
+            package_path = directory / name / 'package.json'
+            if not package_path.exists():
+                assert metadata.get('optional') is True, f'缺少必要依赖: {name}'
+                packages.append({'path': name, 'version': metadata['version'], 'installed': False, 'optional': True})
+                continue
+            installed = json.loads(package_path.read_text())
+            assert installed['version'] == metadata['version']
+            packages.append({'path': name, 'version': installed['version'], 'license': installed.get('license'), 'installed': True})
+        self.save(prefix + '-licenses.json', packages)
+
+    def browser(self, directory, port, name):
+        log_path = self.output / (name + '-server.log')
+        argv = ['node', str(directory / 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'preview', '--host', '127.0.0.1',
+                '--port', str(port), '--strictPort']
+        record = {'argv': argv, 'cwd': str(directory), 'port': port, 'started_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
+        with log_path.open('w') as log:
+            server = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=directory, env=self.env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
+            record['pid'] = server.pid
+            self.save(name + '-server.json', record)
+            try:
+                deadline = time.monotonic() + 30
+                # 启动探针只处理尚未监听的连接错误，浏览器与命令失败继续抛出。
+                while True:
+                    assert server.poll() is None, '预览服务启动失败'
+                    try:
+                        with urllib.request.urlopen(f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}/', timeout=1) as response:
+                            assert response.status == 200
+                            break
+                    except urllib.error.URLError:
+                        if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
+                            raise
+                        time.sleep(.1)
+                self.run(['node', 'scripts/fe-base/camera-regression.mjs', f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}',
+                          str(self.output / (name + '-camera-regression.json'))], timeout=600)
+                self.run(['node', 'scripts/fe-base/browser.mjs', f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}',
+                          str(self.output / (name + '-browser.json'))], timeout=1200)
+                try:
+                    with urllib.request.urlopen(f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}/not-present-fe-base.js') as response:
+                        content_type = response.headers['Content-Type']
+                        assert response.status != 200 or 'javascript' not in content_type
+                        self.save(name + '-missing-resource.json', {'status': response.status, 'content_type': content_type,
+                                                                   'is_javascript': False})
+                except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
+                    assert error.code == 404
+                    self.save(name + '-missing-resource.json', {'status': error.code, 'is_javascript': False})
+            finally:
+                server.terminate()
+                server.wait(timeout=15)
+                record.update(exit_code=server.returncode, stopped_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
+                self.save(name + '-server.json', record)
+

+    assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']).decode().strip() == args.candidate, 'HEAD 必须等于 C'
+    assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain']).decode().strip() == '', '候选工作树必须干净'
+    assert output.is_relative_to(root / '.scratch-runtime'), '输出必须在专用忽略目录'
+    assert not output.exists(), '保留原始证据，使用新输出目录'
+    output.mkdir(parents=True)
+    run = Run(root, output)
+    git = run.git
+    if args.clean:
+        assert '.scratch-runtime' in root.parts and root.name.startswith('clean-'), '需要任务目录内独立干净检出'
+        assert git('rev-parse', '--abbrev-ref', 'HEAD') == 'HEAD', '干净检出必须分离至准确 C'
+        assert Path(git('rev-parse', '--path-format=absolute', '--git-common-dir')) == root / '.git'
+    assert git('remote', 'get-url', 'origin') == ORIGIN

+    for name in ['criteria.md', 'upstream-manifest.json', 'browser-environment.json']:
+        expected = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', args.criteria + ':evidence/FE-BASE/' + name])
+        assert (root / 'evidence/FE-BASE' / name).read_bytes() == expected
+    assert git('rev-parse', IMPORT + ':vendor/turbine-explorer') == TREE
+    trailers = git('show', '-s', '--format=%B', IMPORT + '^2')
+    assert 'git-subtree-dir: vendor/turbine-explorer' in trailers
+    assert 'git-subtree-split: ' + UPSTREAM in trailers
+    entries = json.loads((root / 'evidence/FE-BASE/upstream-manifest.json').read_text())

+    actual_files = {}

+    for name, metadata in entries.items():
+        original_bytes = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', IMPORT + ':vendor/turbine-explorer/' + name])
+        assert sha(original_bytes) == metadata['sha256'] and len(original_bytes) == metadata['bytes'], name
+        actual_bytes = (vendor / name).read_bytes()

+        if actual_files[name] != metadata:
+            assert name == 'src/component-inspector.ts', f'未登记的上游改动: {name}'

+    tracked_vendor = git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', args.candidate, '--', 'vendor/turbine-explorer').splitlines()
+    assert set(tracked_vendor) == {'vendor/turbine-explorer/' + name for name in entries}

+    for revision in [args.criteria, IMPORT, args.candidate]:

+    # 原资产、冻结、证据和历史工具按已集成基准逐字节回归。

+    if not args.clean:

+# Turbine Explorer
+
+A composable gas turbine study, built with procedural Three.js geometry.
+Open the casing, separate the assemblies, and look inside a cooled turbine blade.
+
+[Open the interactive model](https://labs.jizhang.io/gas-turbine/?lang=en) · [中文](https://labs.jizhang.io/gas-turbine/?lang=zh)
+
+[![Exploded assembly with interactive view and airflow controls](docs/exploded.png)](https://labs.jizhang.io/gas-turbine/?lang=en&chapter=2&service=major&quality=high&background=white)
+
+Separate the casing and assemblies. Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, then inspect a component.
+
+[![Cooled blade with selectable coating layers and internal cooling flow](docs/cooled-blade.png)](https://labs.jizhang.io/gas-turbine/?lang=en&inspect=blade&quality=high)
+
+Go inside a cooled blade. Hover or focus a material label to highlight its layer; click to keep it selected.
+Both images are screenshots of the running model, not manufacturer renders.
+
+## Explore
+
+- Cutaway, enclosed and exploded assembly views.
+- Component selection, extraction, orbit and close inspection.
+- A cooled blade with internal passages, cooling-flow animation and a representative coating stack.
+- Rotor motion, airflow, combustion cues and quiet, opt-in synthesized sound.
+- English and Chinese, adjustable render quality and household-energy equivalents with visible assumptions.
+- Live backgrounds: navy blueprint, white paper with blue drafting lines, white studio and graphite studio.
+
+This is an independent educational visualization inspired by public GE Vernova 9HA references.
+It is not affiliated with or endorsed by GE Vernova, not manufacturer CAD, not CFD,
+and not a maintenance or operating procedure. Geometry, removal paths and flow effects are illustrative.
+The cooled blade is a generic teaching model, not a disclosed 9HA.02 blade design.
+
+## Run
+
+Requires Node.js 22.18 or newer and a WebGL-capable browser.
+
+```sh
+npm ci
+npm run dev
+```
+
+The home page opens the English cutaway exhibition. Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom,
+choose the exploded view to separate assemblies, and open the cooled-blade study.
+Sound starts only after a user gesture. The compact **Quality** panel is available on the machine
+and every component view. Balanced, Fine and Showcase share one saved setting, with the current
+render resolution shown in pixels. Desktop starts in Fine; small screens start in Balanced.
+Use `?quality=ultra` for a presentation link. Supersampling sharpens the same geometry;
+the longest render edge is capped at 4096 pixels to bound GPU memory use.
+Choose **Quality → Background** to change the backdrop without changing the metal materials,
+camera or render quality. The setting is shared with component close-ups and saved locally.
+Deep links accept `background=blueprint`, `paper`, `white` or `graphite`.
+
+```sh
+npm test
+npm run build
+npm run preview
+```
+
+The output is a static `dist/` directory. No backend, server-side GPU, API key or database is needed.
+
+## Structure
+
+| File | Purpose |
+| --- | --- |
+| `src/turbine.ts` | Whole-machine assembly, geometry and component hierarchy |
+| `src/sectioned-case.ts` | Complementary casing sections |
+| `src/service-state.ts` | Exploded-view poses and motion interlocks |
+| `src/component-inspector.ts` | Component extraction and independent inspection |
+| `src/blade-study.ts` | Cooled-blade geometry and coating study |
+| `src/exhibition.ts` | Exhibition controls and walkthrough |
+| `src/audio.ts` | Procedural Web Audio sound design |
+| `src/energy.ts` | Energy-equivalence assumptions and calculation |
+
+## Deploy
+
+Deploy `dist/` to any static host for a standalone installation.
+For Ji Zhang Labs, run `npm run build:labs`: this produces `dist-labs/` with a Labs index
+and the application at `/gas-turbine/`. For Cloudflare Pages Git integration, select this repository,
+use build command `npm test && npm run build:labs`, output directory `dist-labs`, and Node.js 22.18 or newer.
+Attach your chosen subdomain in the project's Custom domains settings before creating its DNS record.
+Never put Cloudflare credentials in source files or frontend environment variables.
+
+The Labs publishing target is `https://labs.jizhang.io/gas-turbine/`. Update canonical URLs,
+Open Graph / Twitter metadata and `hosting/sitemap.xml` when deploying to another domain.
+Social-preview tags are in the initial HTML so crawlers do not need to execute WebGL or JavaScript.
+
+## Sources and licensing

+# Technical sources and limits
+
+This project interprets public material; it is not a dimensionally validated engineering model.
+
+- GE Vernova 9HA product information: https://www.gevernova.com/gas-power/products/gas-turbines/9ha
+- HA architecture: https://www.gevernova.com/gas-power/resources/articles/2025/the-evolution-of-the-ha-gas-turbines
+- Heavy-duty operating and maintenance considerations: https://www.gevernova.com/content/dam/gepower-new/global/en_US/downloads/gas-new-site/resources/reference/ger-3620p-heavy-duty-gas-turbine-operating-and-maintenance-considerations.pdf
+- DOE / NETL coatings chapter: https://netl.doe.gov/sites/default/files/gas-turbine-handbook/4-4-2.pdf
+- Nickel superalloy background: https://smg.msm.cam.ac.uk/outreach/articles/nickel-superalloy-turbine-blade
+- Turbine cooling background: https://www.nasa.gov/special-projects-laboratory-turbine-cooling/
+
+The blade illustrates a representative nickel-based superalloy, MCrAlY bond coat,
+alumina thermally grown oxide and YSZ thermal barrier. The actual 9HA.02 alloy grade,
+crystal structure, coating recipe and internal passage geometry were not confirmed.
+Coating thickness and separation are exaggerated. Grey finishes are illustrative, not measured color data.
+
+Blade counts, profiles, clearances, casing thickness and hidden piping are approximations.
+The 16-can combustor arrangement is an inference, not a confirmed current product specification.
+Exploded positions describe component relationships, not a validated lifting sequence.
+Rotation and airflow are slowed or stylized for legibility; they are not fluid or thermal simulations.
+
+The energy display uses the cited nominal 9HA.02 output and a selectable daily household demand.
+It compares energy quantities, not guaranteed household supply, and excludes transmission losses.
+
+Reference images, PDFs and video copies remain outside the public distribution.

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import * as THREE from 'three';
+import { createTurbineModel, rotateRotor } from '../src/turbine.ts';
+import { caseRadiusAt } from '../src/sectioned-case.ts';
+
+const model = createTurbineModel();
+model.root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
+const ancestorsInclude = (object, parent) => {
+  for (let node = object; node; node = node.parent) if (node === parent) return true;
+  return false;
+};
+const fixed = [];
+const moving = [];
+const stages = [];
+const turbineRows = [];
+let lugs = 0;
+model.root.traverse(object => {
+  const row = object.userData.bladeRow;
+  if (row) {
+    assert.equal(ancestorsInclude(object, model.rotor), row.role === 'rotating', `${object.name}: wrong motion parent`);
+    (row.role === 'rotating' ? moving : fixed).push([object, object.matrixWorld.clone()]);
+    if (object.name.startsWith('turbine-rotor-')) stages.push(row);
+    if (object.name.startsWith('turbine-')) {
+      object.geometry.computeBoundingBox();
+      turbineRows.push({ min: row.x + object.geometry.boundingBox.min.x, max: row.x + object.geometry.boundingBox.max.x });
+    }
+  }
+  if (object.name === 'surface-attached-lifting-lug') {
+    lugs++;
+    const position = object.geometry.getAttribute('position');
+    let footOffset = Infinity;
+    for (let i = 0; i < position.count; i++) {
+      const x = object.position.x + position.getX(i), z = object.position.z + position.getZ(i);
+      const r = caseRadiusAt(object.userData.attachment.stations, x);
+      const offset = position.getY(i) - Math.sqrt(r * r - z * z);
+      footOffset = Math.min(footOffset, offset);
+    }
+    assert(footOffset < -.02 && footOffset > -.08, 'Lifting lug foot must embed in its actual casing');
+  }
+});
+assert.equal(stages.length, 4);
+// The featured cooled-blade entry must resolve to the first hot turbine row,
+// downstream of the nozzle row, never the inlet compressor row.
+const featuredRow = model.root.getObjectByName('turbine-rotor-1');
+const firstNozzle = model.root.getObjectByName('turbine-stator-1');
+const inletCompressor = model.root.getObjectByName('compressor-rotor-01');
+assert(featuredRow && firstNozzle && inletCompressor);
+assert(ancestorsInclude(featuredRow, model.rotor));
+assert(!ancestorsInclude(firstNozzle, model.rotor));
+assert(featuredRow.userData.bladeRow.x > firstNozzle.userData.bladeRow.x);
+assert(firstNozzle.userData.bladeRow.x > inletCompressor.userData.bladeRow.x);
+assert.equal(featuredRow.userData.bladeRow.x, Math.min(...stages.map(row => row.x)));
+stages.sort((a, b) => a.x - b.x);
+for (let i = 1; i < stages.length; i++) assert(stages[i].tip > stages[i - 1].tip, 'Turbine annulus must expand downstream');
+assert.equal(lugs, 4);
+turbineRows.sort((a, b) => a.min - b.min);
+for (let i = 1; i < turbineRows.length; i++) assert(turbineRows[i].min > turbineRows[i - 1].max, 'Turbine rotor and stator airfoils must not interpenetrate');
+assert.equal(moving.length, 18, '14 compressor and 4 turbine rotor rows');
+assert(fixed.length >= 17, 'Compressor and turbine stationary rows present');
+
+// Front support regression: closed, positive-winding webs must connect to the
+// continuous carrier, stay below the cut plane, and remain outside the shaft.
+const frontCarrier = model.root.getObjectByName('continuous-lower-bearing-carrier');
+const upperCarrier = model.root.getObjectByName('removable-upper-bearing-carrier');
+const inletWebs = model.root.getObjectByName('integrated-inlet-support-webs');
+assert(frontCarrier && upperCarrier && inletWebs);
+assert.equal(inletWebs.children.length, 3);
+assert(ancestorsInclude(upperCarrier, model.casing));
+assert(!model.root.getObjectByName('front-bearing-axial-load-brace'));
+assert(!model.root.getObjectByName('front-bearing-split-bed'));
+for (const web of inletWebs.children) {
+  assert(ancestorsInclude(web, model.stator));
+  const p = web.geometry.getAttribute('position');
+  const ids = web.geometry.index.array;
+  let volume = 0;
+  const a = new THREE.Vector3(), b = new THREE.Vector3(), c = new THREE.Vector3();
+  for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i += 3) {
+    a.fromBufferAttribute(p, ids[i]); b.fromBufferAttribute(p, ids[i + 1]); c.fromBufferAttribute(p, ids[i + 2]);
+    volume += a.dot(b.cross(c)) / 6;
+  }
+  assert(volume > .05, `${web.name}: outward-wound closed solid`);
+  const edges = new Map();
+  for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i += 3) for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
+    const x = ids[i + k], y = ids[i + (k + 1) % 3];
+    const key = x < y ? `${x}:${y}` : `${y}:${x}`;
+    edges.set(key, (edges.get(key) ?? 0) + 1);
+  }
+  assert([...edges.values()].every(count => count === 2), 'No open support edges');
+  for (let i = 0; i < p.count; i++) {
+    assert(p.getY(i) < 0, 'Support does not cross the cut plane');
+    assert(Math.hypot(p.getY(i), p.getZ(i)) > .7, 'Support clears the rotor journal');
+  }
+  for (let i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
+    const r = Math.hypot(p.getY(i), p.getZ(i));
+    assert(r > .72 && r < .98, 'Support root embedded within lower carrier wall');
+    assert(Math.abs(p.getX(i) - frontCarrier.position.x) < 1.06, 'Support root inside carrier axial span');
+  }
+  fixed.push([web, web.matrixWorld.clone()]);
+}
+
+const covers = model.combustorModules.map(module => module.getObjectByName('combustor-can-and-end-cover'));
+const lowerModules = model.combustorModules.filter(module => module.userData.cutawayVisible);
+assert.equal(lowerModules.length, model.combustorModules.length / 2, 'Cutaway retains the complete lower semicircle');
+for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
+  assert.equal(lowerModules.filter(module => Math.sign(module.userData.serviceDirection.z) === side).length, lowerModules.length / 2,
+    'Both lower casing flanks retain the same number of combustor covers');
+}
+for (const module of model.combustorModules) {
+  assert.equal(module.userData.cutawayVisible, module.userData.serviceDirection.y <= 0, 'Visibility follows the actual horizontal casing cut');
+}
+for (let i = 0; i < covers.length; i++) {
+  assert(covers[i].position.equals(covers[0].position), 'End covers must not have view-specific axial offsets');
+  assert(Math.abs(model.combustorModules[i].rotation.x - (i * Math.PI / 8 + Math.PI / 16)) < 1e-9);
+  const duct = model.combustorModules[i].getObjectByName('connected-combustor-transition');
+  assert(duct, 'Each burner needs its own attached transition');
+  assert.deepEqual(duct.userData.attachment.localStart, covers[i].position.toArray());
+  fixed.push([moduleAt(i), moduleAt(i).matrixWorld.clone()]);
+}
+function moduleAt(i) { return model.combustorModules[i]; }
+for (const group of [model.stator, model.casing, model.combustion, model.exhaust]) fixed.push([group, group.matrixWorld.clone()]);
+rotateRotor(model.rotor, .5, 1.4);
+model.root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
+for (const [object, matrix] of fixed) assert(object.matrixWorld.equals(matrix), `${object.name}: stationary part rotated`);
+for (const [object, matrix] of moving) assert(!object.matrixWorld.equals(matrix), `${object.name}: rotor row failed to rotate`);
+console.log('PASS: expanding turbine stages, attached lugs, consistent combustor ring, connected transitions, rotating vs stationary hierarchy.');
+
+assert(model.lowerCasing.children.length > 10, 'Lower casing must be a real removable assembly');
+assert(ancestorsInclude(model.lowerCasing, model.stator));
+const beforeExpansion = [];
+model.root.traverse(object => { if (object instanceof THREE.Mesh) beforeExpansion.push([object, object.matrixWorld.clone()]); });
+model.lowerCasing.position.y = -3.4;
+model.root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
+const expectedDrop = new THREE.Vector3(0, -3.4, 0).applyMatrix4(model.stator.matrixWorld)
+  .sub(new THREE.Vector3().setFromMatrixPosition(model.stator.matrixWorld));
+for (const [object, matrix] of beforeExpansion) {
+  if (ancestorsInclude(object, model.lowerCasing)) {
+    const travel = new THREE.Vector3().setFromMatrixPosition(object.matrixWorld).sub(new THREE.Vector3().setFromMatrixPosition(matrix));
+    assert(travel.distanceTo(expectedDrop) < 1e-8, 'Complete lower assembly travels together in the tilted machine frame');
+  } else assert(object.matrixWorld.equals(matrix), 'Lower casing separation must not drag core rows or bearings');
+}

+import * as THREE from 'three';
+import './backdrop.css';
+
+export type Backdrop = 'blueprint' | 'paper' | 'white' | 'graphite';
+const presets: Record<Backdrop, { center: string; edge: string; grid?: string; light: boolean }> = {
+  blueprint: { center: '#203d51', edge: '#081624', grid: '#8bc6e1', light: false },
+  paper: { center: '#ffffff', edge: '#ffffff', grid: '#0050d0', light: true },
+  white: { center: '#ffffff', edge: '#e3e5e5', light: true },
+  graphite: { center: '#353b40', edge: '#101418', light: false },
+};
+const valid = (value: string | null): value is Backdrop => !!value && Object.hasOwn(presets, value);
+let saved: string | null = null;
+try { saved = localStorage.getItem('turbine-backdrop'); } catch { /* Optional persistence. */ }
+const requested = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('background');
+let current: Backdrop = valid(requested) ? requested : valid(saved) ? saved : 'blueprint';
+const listeners = new Set<() => void>();
+function applyTheme() {
+  document.documentElement.dataset.backdrop = current;
+  document.documentElement.dataset.backdropTone = presets[current].light ? 'light' : 'dark';
+}
+applyTheme();
+export function setBackdrop(value: Backdrop) {
+  current = value; applyTheme();
+  try { localStorage.setItem('turbine-backdrop', value); } catch { /* Keep the live selection. */ }
+  const url = new URL(location.href); url.searchParams.set('background', value);
+  history.replaceState(null, '', url);
+  listeners.forEach(listener => listener());
+}
+
+// An opaque scene background, not an overlay, reflection map or physical floor.
+// The render depth and antialiasing resolve the model over this sheet in one frame.
+export function createBackdrop(scene: THREE.Scene) {
+  const surface = document.createElement('canvas');
+  const context = surface.getContext('2d')!;
+  const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(surface);
+  texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
+  texture.minFilter = THREE.LinearFilter; texture.magFilter = THREE.LinearFilter;
+  texture.generateMipmaps = false;
+  let width = 0, height = 0, painted: Backdrop | undefined;
+  function resize(w: number, h: number) {
+    w = Math.max(1, Math.round(w)); h = Math.max(1, Math.round(h));
+    if (w === width && h === height && painted === current) { scene.background = texture; return; }
+    width = w; height = h; painted = current;
+    const scale = Math.min(2, 2048 / Math.max(w, h));
+    surface.width = Math.round(w * scale); surface.height = Math.round(h * scale);
+    context.setTransform(scale, 0, 0, scale, 0, 0);
+    const preset = presets[current];
+    // Keep white paper white after the scene's photographic tone mapping.
+    // This changes only the background, never the metal lighting/environment.
+    scene.backgroundIntensity = current === 'paper' ? 3.5 : preset.light ? 1.8 : 1;
+    const gradient = context.createRadialGradient(w * .54, h * .43, 0, w * .54, h * .43, Math.max(w, h) * .72);
+    gradient.addColorStop(0, preset.center); gradient.addColorStop(1, preset.edge);
+    context.fillStyle = gradient; context.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
+    if (preset.grid) {
+      context.strokeStyle = preset.grid;
+      const step = w < 560 ? 30 : 40;
+      for (let axis = 0; axis < 2; axis++) {
+        for (let p = 0; p <= (axis ? h : w); p += step) {
+          const major = p % (step * 5) === 0;
+          context.globalAlpha = current === 'paper' ? (major ? .98 : .85) : (major ? .14 : .055);
+          context.lineWidth = current === 'paper' && major ? 1.25 : 1;
+          context.beginPath();
+          context.moveTo(axis ? 0 : p + .5, axis ? p + .5 : 0);
+          context.lineTo(axis ? w : p + .5, axis ? p + .5 : h);
+          context.stroke();
+        }
+      }
+      context.globalAlpha = 1;
+    }
+    texture.needsUpdate = true; scene.background = texture;
+  }

+  return { resize, restore: () => { scene.background = texture; } };
+}
+
+export function appendBackdropControl(panel: HTMLElement) {
+  const label = document.createElement('label');
+  label.className = 'backdrop-control';
+  label.innerHTML = '<span>背景</span><select aria-label="背景"><option value="blueprint">深蓝蓝图</option><option value="paper">白底蓝线</option><option value="white">白色摄影棚</option><option value="graphite">深灰摄影棚</option></select>';
+  const select = label.querySelector('select')!;
+  select.value = current;
+  select.onchange = () => setBackdrop(select.value as Backdrop);
+  panel.append(label);
+  listeners.add(() => { select.value = current; });
+}

+import { caseRadiusAt, type CaseStation } from './sectioned-case.ts';

+/** Public-reference approximation: broad fixed webs, not a second row of blades. */
+export function createInletSupportWebs(stations: CaseStation[], material: THREE.Material) {
+  const group = new THREE.Group();
+  group.name = 'integrated-inlet-support-webs';
+  for (const [index, angle] of [Math.PI * 7 / 6, Math.PI * 1.5, Math.PI * 11 / 6].entries()) {
+    const positions: number[] = [], indices: number[] = [], uvs: number[] = [];

+      const span = j / spanSteps;

+      const halfThickness = .065 + .11 * Math.pow(1 - span, 4) + .12 * Math.pow(span, 6);
+      for (let k = 0; k < ringSteps; k++) {
+        const phase = k / ringSteps * Math.PI * 2;
+        const x = -7.08 + Math.cos(phase) * chord / 2;
+        const wall = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(.24, .49, THREE.MathUtils.clamp((-x - 8.05) / .15, 0, 1));
+        const outerContact = caseRadiusAt(stations, x) - wall + .065;
+        const r = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(.87, outerContact, span);
+        const offset = Math.sin(phase) * halfThickness;
+        positions.push(x, Math.sin(angle) * r + Math.cos(angle) * offset,
+          Math.cos(angle) * r - Math.sin(angle) * offset);
+        uvs.push(k / ringSteps, span);
+      }
+    }
+    for (let j = 0; j < spanSteps; j++) {
+      for (let k = 0; k < ringSteps; k++) {
+        const a = j * ringSteps + k, b = j * ringSteps + (k + 1) % ringSteps;
+        indices.push(a, b, a + ringSteps, b, b + ringSteps, a + ringSteps);
+      }
+    }
+    for (const end of [0, spanSteps]) {
+      const center = positions.length / 3;
+      const offset = end * ringSteps;
+      const sum = new THREE.Vector3();
+      for (let k = 0; k < ringSteps; k++) sum.add(new THREE.Vector3().fromArray(positions, (offset + k) * 3));

+    geometry.computeVertexNormals();

+export type RenderQuality = 'balanced' | 'high' | 'ultra';
+const requested = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('quality');
+const valid = (value: string | null): value is RenderQuality => ['balanced', 'high', 'ultra'].includes(value ?? '');

+export const getRenderQuality = () => quality;
+// High presets supersample even on a 1x display. Bound the longest GPU surface.
+export function renderPixelRatio(width: number, height: number) {
+  const ratio = quality === 'ultra' ? 3 : quality === 'high' ? 2 : Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 1.35);

+  const boreCenters: THREE.Vector2[] = [];
+  const inner = (s: CaseStation) => s.r - s.wall - .1;
+  const outer = (s: CaseStation) => s.r + (s.lip ?? .3) + .12;
+  shape.moveTo(stations[0].x, side * outer(stations[0]));
+  stations.slice(1).forEach(s => shape.lineTo(s.x, side * outer(s)));

+    bolts.name = 'upper-casing-joint-bolts';
+    parent.add(bolts);

+      dummy.position.set(center.x, .197, center.y);

+export function serviceInterlock(stage: number, blend: number) {
+  return stage > 0 || blend > .003;

+export function serviceTarget(stage: number, rotorPercent: number, kinematicDemo: boolean) {

+  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (value - start) / (end - start)));

+    rotorSweep: THREE.MathUtils.lerp(.16, .035, t),

+function createBladeGeometry(spec: BladeSpec) {
+  const vertices: number[] = [];
+  const uvs: number[] = [];
+  const indices: number[] = [];
+  const sectionCount = 12;
+  const chordSamples = 16;
+  const outlineCount = chordSamples * 2;
+
+  for (let i = 0; i < sectionCount; i++) {
+    const t = i / (sectionCount - 1);
+    const radial = spec.span * t;
+    const aerodynamicT = Math.max(0, (t - .055) / .945);
+    const rootFlare = Math.exp(-t * 28);
+    const chord = spec.chord * (1 - spec.taper * aerodynamicT) * (1 + .06 * rootFlare);
+    const thick = spec.thickness * (1 - .46 * aerodynamicT) * (1 + .3 * rootFlare);
+    const a = spec.twist * (.22 + .78 * Math.pow(t, .86));
+    const centerX = spec.sweep * aerodynamicT * aerodynamicT + spec.chord * .025 * Math.sin(t * Math.PI);
+    const centerZ = spec.lean * Math.sin(aerodynamicT * Math.PI * .82) + spec.chord * .018 * Math.sin(t * Math.PI);
+
+    const pushPoint = (u: number, side: number) => {
+      const axial = (u - .5) * chord;
+      // A closed NACA-like foil gives the leading edge a real radius and keeps
+      // the trailing edge crisp. Asymmetric camber makes the blade read as an
+      // aerodynamic casting instead of a repeated decorative fin.
+      const foil = .2969 * Math.sqrt(Math.max(u, 0))
+        - .126 * u
+        - .3516 * u * u
+        + .2843 * u * u * u
+        - .1036 * u * u * u * u;
+      const halfThickness = thick * THREE.MathUtils.clamp(foil / .1001, 0, 1.05) * .5;
+      const camberPeak = .42;
+      const camberProfile = u < camberPeak
+        ? (2 * camberPeak * u - u * u) / (camberPeak * camberPeak)
+        : ((1 - 2 * camberPeak) + 2 * camberPeak * u - u * u) / ((1 - camberPeak) * (1 - camberPeak));
+      const camber = thick * .38 * camberProfile * (1 - .16 * t);
+      const tangential = camber + side * halfThickness;
+      const x = centerX + axial * Math.cos(a) - tangential * Math.sin(a);
+      const z = centerZ + axial * Math.sin(a) + tangential * Math.cos(a);
+      vertices.push(x, radial, z);
+      uvs.push(u, t);
+    };
+
+    for (let j = 0; j <= chordSamples; j++) pushPoint(j / chordSamples, 1);
+    for (let j = chordSamples - 1; j >= 1; j--) pushPoint(j / chordSamples, -1);
+  }
+
+  for (let i = 0; i < sectionCount - 1; i++) {
+    const row = i * outlineCount;
+    const next = (i + 1) * outlineCount;
+    for (let j = 0; j < outlineCount; j++) {
+      const k = (j + 1) % outlineCount;
+      indices.push(row + j, next + k, next + j, row + j, row + k, next + k);
+    }
+  }
+
+  const rootCenter = vertices.length / 3;
+  vertices.push(0, 0, 0);
+  uvs.push(.5, 0);
+  const tipCenter = rootCenter + 1;
+  vertices.push(spec.sweep, spec.span, spec.lean * Math.sin(Math.PI * .8));
+  uvs.push(.5, 1);
+  const tipRow = (sectionCount - 1) * outlineCount;
+  for (let j = 0; j < outlineCount; j++) {
+    const k = (j + 1) % outlineCount;
+    indices.push(rootCenter, k, j);
+    indices.push(tipCenter, tipRow + j, tipRow + k);
+  }
+
+  const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
+  geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(vertices, 3));
+  geometry.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2));
+  geometry.setIndex(indices);
+  geometry.computeVertexNormals();
+  return geometry;
+}
+
+function createTransitionDuctGeometry() {
+  const positions: number[] = [];
+  const indices: number[] = [];
+  const samples = 18;
+  const sections = [
+    { x: 1.85, radial: 2.67, radialRadius: .33, tangentRadius: .29, corner: 2.05 },
+    { x: 2.07, radial: 2.35, radialRadius: .3, tangentRadius: .3, corner: 2.2 },
+    { x: 2.37, radial: 1.94, radialRadius: .26, tangentRadius: .31, corner: 2.55 },
+    { x: 2.78, radial: 1.68, radialRadius: .24, tangentRadius: .315, corner: 2.85 },
+  ];
+
+  for (const wallInset of [0, .045]) for (const section of sections) {
+    for (let i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
+      const angle = (i / samples) * Math.PI * 2;
+      const cosine = Math.cos(angle);
+      const sine = Math.sin(angle);
+      const radialShape = Math.sign(cosine) * Math.pow(Math.abs(cosine), 2 / section.corner);
+      const tangentShape = Math.sign(sine) * Math.pow(Math.abs(sine), 2 / section.corner);
+      positions.push(
+        section.x,
+        section.radial + radialShape * (section.radialRadius - wallInset),
+        tangentShape * (section.tangentRadius - wallInset),
+      );
+    }
+  }
+
+  const layerSize = sections.length * samples;
+  for (let layer = 0; layer < 2; layer++) for (let section = 0; section < sections.length - 1; section++) {
+    const row = layer * layerSize + section * samples;
+    const next = row + samples;
+    for (let i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
+      const j = (i + 1) % samples;
+      if (layer === 0) indices.push(row + i, next + j, next + i, row + i, row + j, next + j);
+      else indices.push(row + i, next + i, next + j, row + i, next + j, row + j);
+    }
+  }
+
+  // Open gas passages with wall thickness, not solid black end plugs.
+  for (const end of [0, sections.length - 1]) for (let i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
+    const j = (i + 1) % samples;
+    const a = end * samples + i, b = end * samples + j;
+    const c = a + layerSize, d = b + layerSize;
+    if (end === 0) indices.push(a, c, d, a, d, b);
+    else indices.push(a, b, d, a, d, c);
+  }
+
+  const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
+  geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
+  geometry.setIndex(indices);
+  geometry.computeVertexNormals();
+  return geometry;
+}

+export function cameraChangedAfterInput({selector, reference, operation}) {
+  const value = window.__feBaseObserve(selector);
+  const matrix = value?.main[0]?.matrix;
+  if (!matrix) return false;
+  if (operation === 'rotate') {
+    return [0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10].some(index => Math.abs(matrix[index] - reference[index]) > 1e-5);
+  }
+  const current = Math.hypot(...matrix.slice(12, 15));
+  const previous = Math.hypot(...reference.slice(12, 15));
+  if (operation === 'zoom-in') return current < previous - .01;
+  if (operation === 'zoom-out') return current > previous + .01;
+  throw new Error('未知镜头操作');
+}

+export function cameraChangedAfterInput({selector, reference, operation, afterInput}) {
+  if (!Number.isInteger(afterInput)) throw new Error('需要操作前的实际输入序号');
+  if (!['rotate', 'zoom-in', 'zoom-out'].includes(operation)) throw new Error('未知镜头操作');
+  const value = window.__feBaseObserve(selector);
+  const camera = value?.main[0];
+  if (!camera) return false;
+  const input = value.inputEvents.findLast(event => event.sequence > afterInput
+    && event.canvasId === value.canvasId && event.trusted && event.completed
+    && (operation === 'rotate' ? event.type === 'pointermove' && event.buttons === 1
+      : event.type === 'wheel' && event.deltaY === (operation === 'zoom-in' ? -600 : 600)
+        && event.defaultPrevented));
+  if (!input || !(camera.viewUpload > input.viewUploadsAtInput
+    && camera.lastDraw > input.drawsAtInput && camera.lastDraw > camera.viewUploadedAtDraw)) return false;
+  const matrix = camera.matrix;
+  if (operation === 'rotate') {
+    return [0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10].some(index => Math.abs(matrix[index] - reference[index]) > 1e-5);
+  }
+  const current = Math.hypot(...matrix.slice(12, 15));
+  const previous = Math.hypot(...reference.slice(12, 15));
+  if (operation === 'zoom-in') return current < previous - .01;
+  if (operation === 'zoom-out') return current > previous + .01;
+  throw new Error('未知镜头操作');
+}

+// 观察实际 GPU 调用，保持原参数、返回值和渲染行为。
+(() => {
+  const names = new WeakMap();
+  const programs = new WeakMap();
+  const states = new Map();
+  let nextProgram = 0;
+  let nextCanvas = 0;
+  let nextInput = 0;
+  const inputEvents = [];
+  const inputRecords = new WeakMap();
+  const state = gl => {
+    let value = states.get(gl.canvas);
+    if (!value) {
+      value = {canvas: gl.canvas, canvasId: ++nextCanvas, draws: 0, viewUploads: 0,
+        programs: {}, frameDraws: [], currentFrameDraws: 0};
+      states.set(gl.canvas, value);
+    }
+    return value;
+  };
+  for (const type of ['pointerdown', 'pointermove', 'pointerup', 'wheel']) {
+    document.addEventListener(type, event => {
+      const canvas = states.get(event.target);
+      const data = {sequence: ++nextInput, type, at: performance.now(), trusted: event.isTrusted,
+        target: event.target.id || event.target.tagName, canvasId: canvas?.canvasId,
+        x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY, buttons: event.buttons,
+        deltaX: event.deltaX, deltaY: event.deltaY, deltaMode: event.deltaMode,
+        drawsAtInput: canvas?.draws, viewUploadsAtInput: canvas?.viewUploads,
+        defaultPrevented: event.defaultPrevented, completed: false};
+      inputEvents.push(data);
+      if (inputEvents.length > 100) inputEvents.shift();
+      inputRecords.set(event, data);
+    }, {capture: true, passive: true});
+    document.addEventListener(type, event => {
+      const data = inputRecords.get(event);
+      data.completed = true;
+      data.defaultPrevented = event.defaultPrevented;
+    }, {passive: true});
+  }
+  const prototype = WebGL2RenderingContext.prototype;
+  const getLocation = prototype.getUniformLocation;
+  prototype.getUniformLocation = function(program, name) {
+    const location = getLocation.call(this, program, name);
+    if (!programs.has(program)) programs.set(program, ++nextProgram);
+    if (location) names.set(location, {name, program: programs.get(program)});
+    return location;
+  };
+  const matrix = prototype.uniformMatrix4fv;
+  prototype.uniformMatrix4fv = function(location, transpose, values, ...rest) {
+    const result = matrix.call(this, location, transpose, values, ...rest);
+    const metadata = names.get(location);
+    if (metadata && ['viewMatrix', 'projectionMatrix'].includes(metadata.name)) {
+      const data = state(this);
+      data.programs[metadata.program] ??= {};
+      data.programs[metadata.program][metadata.name] = Array.from(values);
+      if (metadata.name === 'viewMatrix') {
+        data.programs[metadata.program].viewUpload = ++data.viewUploads;
+        data.programs[metadata.program].viewUploadedAtDraw = data.draws;
+      }
+    }
+    return result;
+  };
+  const useProgram = prototype.useProgram;
+  prototype.useProgram = function(program) {
+    const result = useProgram.call(this, program);
+    state(this).activeProgram = program;
+    return result;
+  };
+  for (const method of ['drawElements', 'drawArrays', 'drawElementsInstanced', 'drawArraysInstanced']) {
+    const original = prototype[method];
+    prototype[method] = function(...args) {
+      const result = original.apply(this, args);
+      if (args[method.startsWith('drawArrays') ? 2 : 1] > 0) {
+        const data = state(this);
+        data.draws++;
+        data.currentFrameDraws++;
+        const id = programs.get(data.activeProgram);
+        if (data.programs[id]) data.programs[id].lastDraw = data.draws;
+      }
+      return result;
+    };
+  }
+  const frame = () => {
+    for (const data of states.values()) {
+      if (data.currentFrameDraws) {
+        data.frameDraws.push(data.currentFrameDraws);
+        if (data.frameDraws.length > 20) data.frameDraws.shift();
+        data.currentFrameDraws = 0;
+      }
+    }
+    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
+  };
+  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
+  window.__feBaseObserve = selector => {
+    const data = states.get(document.querySelector(selector));
+    if (!data) return null;
+    // 主场景透视相机 near=.1/far=120；其他 shadow、AO 相机不作为主镜头。
+    const candidates = Object.entries(data.programs).filter(([, value]) => {
+      const p = value.projectionMatrix;
+      const expectedDepth = selector === '#scene' ? 0.20016680567139283 : 0.04000444493832648;
+      return value.viewMatrix && p && Math.abs(p[11] + 1) < 1e-6
+        && Math.abs(p[14] + expectedDepth) < 1e-5;
+    }).sort((a, b) => (b[1].lastDraw ?? 0) - (a[1].lastDraw ?? 0));
+    return {at: performance.now(), timeOrigin: performance.timeOrigin, canvasId: data.canvasId,
+      inputSequence: nextInput, inputEvents: inputEvents.map(event => ({...event})),
+      draws: data.draws, viewUploads: data.viewUploads, frameDraws: data.frameDraws.slice(),
+      programs: data.programs, main: candidates.map(([id, value]) => ({id, matrix: value.viewMatrix,
+        projection: value.projectionMatrix, viewUpload: value.viewUpload,
+        viewUploadedAtDraw: value.viewUploadedAtDraw, lastDraw: value.lastDraw}))};
+  };
+  window.__feBaseResetFrames = selector => {
+    const data = states.get(document.querySelector(selector));
+    if (!data) throw new Error('缺少真实 GPU 观察数据');
+    data.frameDraws = [];
+    data.currentFrameDraws = 0;
+  };
+})();

+class Run:
+    def __init__(self, root, output):
+        self.root = root

+        assert self.env.get('FE_BASE_CHROME'), '需要 FE_BASE_CHROME'
+
+    def save(self, name, value):
+        (self.output / name).write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
+
+    def run(self, argv, cwd=None, timeout=120, expected=0):
+        cwd = cwd or self.root
+        record = {'argv': [str(value) for value in argv], 'cwd': str(cwd),
+                  'at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'exit_code': None}
+        self.commands.append(record)
+        self.save('commands.json', self.commands)
+        try:
+            result = subprocess.run(record['argv'], cwd=cwd, env=self.env, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout)
+            record.update(exit_code=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout.decode(), stderr=result.stderr.decode(),
+                          stdout_sha256=sha(result.stdout), stderr_sha256=sha(result.stderr))
+            assert result.returncode == expected, f'命令退出{result.returncode}: {argv}'
+            return result.stdout.decode().strip()
+        finally:
+            self.save('commands.json', self.commands)
+
+    def git(self, *args, cwd=None):
+        return self.run(['git', *args], cwd=cwd)
+
+    def baseline(self, directory, prefix):
+        for name, command in [('install', ['npm', 'ci']), ('test', ['npm', 'test']),
+                              ('build', ['npm', 'run', 'build']), ('build-labs', ['npm', 'run', 'build:labs'])]:
+            self.run(command, cwd=directory, timeout=600)
+        dependencies = json.loads(self.run(['npm', 'ls', '--all', '--json'], cwd=directory))
+        self.save(prefix + '-dependencies.json', dependencies)
+        lock = json.loads((directory / 'package-lock.json').read_text())
+        packages = []
+        for name, metadata in lock['packages'].items():
+            if not name:
+                continue
+            package_path = directory / name / 'package.json'
+            if not package_path.exists():
+                assert metadata.get('optional') is True, f'缺少必要依赖: {name}'
+                packages.append({'path': name, 'version': metadata['version'], 'installed': False, 'optional': True})
+                continue
+            installed = json.loads(package_path.read_text())
+            assert installed['version'] == metadata['version']
+            packages.append({'path': name, 'version': installed['version'], 'license': installed.get('license'), 'installed': True})
+        self.save(prefix + '-licenses.json', packages)

+    def browser(self, directory, port, name):

+                '--port', str(port), '--strictPort']
+        record = {'argv': argv, 'cwd': str(directory), 'port': port, 'started_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
+        with log_path.open('w') as log:
+            server = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=directory, env=self.env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)

+# Turbine Explorer
+
+A composable gas turbine study, built with procedural Three.js geometry.
+Open the casing, separate the assemblies, and look inside a cooled turbine blade.
+
+[Open the interactive model](https://labs.jizhang.io/gas-turbine/?lang=en) · [中文](https://labs.jizhang.io/gas-turbine/?lang=zh)
+
+[![Exploded assembly with interactive view and airflow controls](docs/exploded.png)](https://labs.jizhang.io/gas-turbine/?lang=en&chapter=2&service=major&quality=high&background=white)
+
+Separate the casing and assemblies. Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, then inspect a component.
+
+[![Cooled blade with selectable coating layers and internal cooling flow](docs/cooled-blade.png)](https://labs.jizhang.io/gas-turbine/?lang=en&inspect=blade&quality=high)
+
+Go inside a cooled blade. Hover or focus a material label to highlight its layer; click to keep it selected.
+Both images are screenshots of the running model, not manufacturer renders.
+
+## Explore
+
+- Cutaway, enclosed and exploded assembly views.
+- Component selection, extraction, orbit and close inspection.
+- A cooled blade with internal passages, cooling-flow animation and a representative coating stack.
+- Rotor motion, airflow, combustion cues and quiet, opt-in synthesized sound.
+- English and Chinese, adjustable render quality and household-energy equivalents with visible assumptions.
+- Live backgrounds: navy blueprint, white paper with blue drafting lines, white studio and graphite studio.
+
+This is an independent educational visualization inspired by public GE Vernova 9HA references.
+It is not affiliated with or endorsed by GE Vernova, not manufacturer CAD, not CFD,
+and not a maintenance or operating procedure. Geometry, removal paths and flow effects are illustrative.
+The cooled blade is a generic teaching model, not a disclosed 9HA.02 blade design.
+
+## Run
+
+Requires Node.js 22.18 or newer and a WebGL-capable browser.
+
+```sh
+npm ci
+npm run dev
+```
+
+The home page opens the English cutaway exhibition. Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom,
+choose the exploded view to separate assemblies, and open the cooled-blade study.
+Sound starts only after a user gesture. The compact **Quality** panel is available on the machine
+and every component view. Balanced, Fine and Showcase share one saved setting, with the current
+render resolution shown in pixels. Desktop starts in Fine; small screens start in Balanced.
+Use `?quality=ultra` for a presentation link. Supersampling sharpens the same geometry;
+the longest render edge is capped at 4096 pixels to bound GPU memory use.
+Choose **Quality → Background** to change the backdrop without changing the metal materials,
+camera or render quality. The setting is shared with component close-ups and saved locally.
+Deep links accept `background=blueprint`, `paper`, `white` or `graphite`.
+
+```sh
+npm test
+npm run build
+npm run preview
+```
+
+The output is a static `dist/` directory. No backend, server-side GPU, API key or database is needed.
+
+## Structure
+
+| File | Purpose |
+| --- | --- |
+| `src/turbine.ts` | Whole-machine assembly, geometry and component hierarchy |
+| `src/sectioned-case.ts` | Complementary casing sections |
+| `src/service-state.ts` | Exploded-view poses and motion interlocks |
+| `src/component-inspector.ts` | Component extraction and independent inspection |
+| `src/blade-study.ts` | Cooled-blade geometry and coating study |
+| `src/exhibition.ts` | Exhibition controls and walkthrough |
+| `src/audio.ts` | Procedural Web Audio sound design |
+| `src/energy.ts` | Energy-equivalence assumptions and calculation |
+
+## Deploy
+
+Deploy `dist/` to any static host for a standalone installation.
+For Ji Zhang Labs, run `npm run build:labs`: this produces `dist-labs/` with a Labs index
+and the application at `/gas-turbine/`. For Cloudflare Pages Git integration, select this repository,
+use build command `npm test && npm run build:labs`, output directory `dist-labs`, and Node.js 22.18 or newer.
+Attach your chosen subdomain in the project's Custom domains settings before creating its DNS record.
+Never put Cloudflare credentials in source files or frontend environment variables.
+
+The Labs publishing target is `https://labs.jizhang.io/gas-turbine/`. Update canonical URLs,
+Open Graph / Twitter metadata and `hosting/sitemap.xml` when deploying to another domain.
+Social-preview tags are in the initial HTML so crawlers do not need to execute WebGL or JavaScript.
+
+## Sources and licensing
+
+Original code and procedural models are MIT-licensed. See [LICENSE](LICENSE) and

+Reference photographs, manufacturer renders, downloaded videos and source-document copies

+

+# Technical sources and limits
+
+This project interprets public material; it is not a dimensionally validated engineering model.
+
+- GE Vernova 9HA product information: https://www.gevernova.com/gas-power/products/gas-turbines/9ha
+- HA architecture: https://www.gevernova.com/gas-power/resources/articles/2025/the-evolution-of-the-ha-gas-turbines
+- Heavy-duty operating and maintenance considerations: https://www.gevernova.com/content/dam/gepower-new/global/en_US/downloads/gas-new-site/resources/reference/ger-3620p-heavy-duty-gas-turbine-operating-and-maintenance-considerations.pdf
+- DOE / NETL coatings chapter: https://netl.doe.gov/sites/default/files/gas-turbine-handbook/4-4-2.pdf
+- Nickel superalloy background: https://smg.msm.cam.ac.uk/outreach/articles/nickel-superalloy-turbine-blade
+- Turbine cooling background: https://www.nasa.gov/special-projects-laboratory-turbine-cooling/
+
+The blade illustrates a representative nickel-based superalloy, MCrAlY bond coat,
+alumina thermally grown oxide and YSZ thermal barrier. The actual 9HA.02 alloy grade,
+crystal structure, coating recipe and internal passage geometry were not confirmed.
+Coating thickness and separation are exaggerated. Grey finishes are illustrative, not measured color data.
+
+Blade counts, profiles, clearances, casing thickness and hidden piping are approximations.
+The 16-can combustor arrangement is an inference, not a confirmed current product specification.
+Exploded positions describe component relationships, not a validated lifting sequence.
+Rotation and airflow are slowed or stylized for legibility; they are not fluid or thermal simulations.
+
+The energy display uses the cited nominal 9HA.02 output and a selectable daily household demand.
+It compares energy quantities, not guaranteed household supply, and excludes transmission losses.
+
+Reference images, PDFs and video copies remain outside the public distribution.

+{
+  "name": "turbine-explorer",
+  "private": true,
+  "version": "0.1.0",
+  "type": "module",
+  "scripts": {
+    "build:labs": "tsc && vite build --base=/gas-turbine/ --outDir dist-labs/gas-turbine && node scripts/package-labs.mjs",
+    "test:energy": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/verify-energy.mjs",
+    "test:language": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/verify-language.mjs",
+    "test:quality": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/verify-quality.mjs",
+    "test:blade": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/verify-blade.mjs",
+    "test:service": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/verify-service.mjs",
+    "test:geometry": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/verify-case.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/verify-assembly.mjs",
+    "dev": "vite --host 127.0.0.1",
+    "build": "tsc && vite build",
+    "preview": "vite preview --host 127.0.0.1",
+    "test": "npm run test:quality && npm run test:energy && npm run test:language && npm run test:blade && npm run test:service && npm run test:geometry"
+  },
+  "dependencies": {
+    "three": "^0.179.1"
+  },
+  "devDependencies": {
+    "@types/three": "^0.179.0",
+    "typescript": "^5.9.2",
+    "vite": "^7.1.3"
+  },
+  "description": "Composable interactive gas turbine and cooled blade study in Three.js",

+  "author": "AlexZhangji",
+  "repository": {
+    "type": "git",
+    "url": "https://github.com/AlexZhangji/turbine-explorer.git"

+    "node": ">=22.18.0"
+  }

+# Studio environment asset
+
+The folder contains two 1K CC0 HDR environments from Poly Haven:
+
+- `poly_haven_studio_1k.hdr`, default neutral product-lighting environment, source: https://polyhaven.com/a/poly_haven_studio, MD5 `a1065f613cb6e0388d82a99dcee23d3b`
+- `studio_kontrast_02_1k.hdr`, high-contrast comparison environment, source: https://polyhaven.com/a/studio_kontrast_02, MD5 `43dc1c74c406d06a5f3b55735b18e64f`
+- License: CC0, https://polyhaven.com/license
+- Retrieved: 2026-09-04
+
+The application uses the neutral map for image-based lighting while retaining its own dark visible background. Add `?env=contrast` for the contrast studio or `?env=cards` for the earlier procedural reflection-card environment. `envrot=100` controls HDR rotation in degrees. Add `&ao=0` to remove SSAO and `&shadows=0` to remove shadow maps from a diagnostic comparison.

+type CaseMaterials = { outer: THREE.Material; inner: THREE.Material; cut: THREE.Material };

+export function caseRadiusAt(stations: CaseStation[], x: number) {
+  let i = 0;
+  while (i < stations.length - 2 && stations[i + 1].x < x) i++;

+          [normal(t0), normal(t0), normal(t1), normal(t1)], inner);
+      }
+    }
+    groups.push({ start: first, count: p.length / 3 - first, materialIndex: inner ? 1 : 0 });
+  }
+  const cutStart = p.length / 3;
+  for (const end of [0, stations.length - 1]) {
+    const station = stations[end];
+    const normal = new THREE.Vector3(end === 0 ? -1 : 1, 0, 0);

+      const t0 = start + arc * i / segments, t1 = start + arc * (i + 1) / segments;

+  mesh.receiveShadow = true;

+export function serviceInterlock(stage: number, blend: number) {

+export function serviceTarget(stage: number, rotorPercent: number, kinematicDemo: boolean) {

+const windowed = (value: number, start: number, end: number) => {
+  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (value - start) / (end - start)));

+function shellSectorX(
+  length: number,
+  radiusLeft: number,
+  radiusRight: number,
+  thickness: number,
+  thetaStart: number,
+  thetaLength: number,
+  material: THREE.Material,
+  segments = 56,
+  innerMaterial: THREE.Material = material,
+  cutMaterial: THREE.Material = material,
+) {
+  const positions: number[] = [];
+  const uvs: number[] = [];
+  const indices: number[] = [];
+  const ringCount = segments + 1;
+  const addVertex = (x: number, radius: number, theta: number) => {
+    positions.push(x, Math.sin(theta) * radius, Math.cos(theta) * radius);
+  };
+
+  for (let side = 0; side < 2; side++) {
+    const x = side === 0 ? -length / 2 : length / 2;
+    const outer = side === 0 ? radiusLeft : radiusRight;
+    for (let layer = 0; layer < 2; layer++) {
+      const radius = outer - layer * thickness;
+      for (let i = 0; i <= segments; i++) {
+        addVertex(x, radius, thetaStart + thetaLength * (i / segments));
+        uvs.push(side, i / segments);
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  const row = (side: number, layer: number) => (side * 2 + layer) * ringCount;
+  const quad = (a: number, b: number, c: number, d: number) => indices.push(a, b, d, a, d, c);
+
+  const outerStart = indices.length;
+  for (let i = 0; i < segments; i++) {
+    quad(row(0, 0) + i, row(1, 0) + i, row(0, 0) + i + 1, row(1, 0) + i + 1);
+  }
+  const outerCount = indices.length - outerStart;
+  const innerStart = indices.length;
+  for (let i = 0; i < segments; i++) {
+    quad(row(1, 1) + i, row(0, 1) + i, row(1, 1) + i + 1, row(0, 1) + i + 1);
+  }
+  const innerCount = indices.length - innerStart;
+  const cutStart = indices.length;
+  for (let i = 0; i < segments; i++) {
+    quad(row(0, 1) + i, row(0, 0) + i, row(0, 1) + i + 1, row(0, 0) + i + 1);
+    quad(row(1, 0) + i, row(1, 1) + i, row(1, 0) + i + 1, row(1, 1) + i + 1);
+  }
+
+  [0, segments].forEach((edge, edgeIndex) => {
+    const a = row(0, 0) + edge;
+    const b = row(1, 0) + edge;
+    const c = row(0, 1) + edge;
+    const d = row(1, 1) + edge;
+    if (edgeIndex === 0) quad(c, d, a, b);
+    else quad(a, b, c, d);
+  });
+
+  const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
+  geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
+  geometry.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2));
+  geometry.setIndex(indices);
+  geometry.addGroup(outerStart, outerCount, 0);
+  geometry.addGroup(innerStart, innerCount, 1);
+  geometry.addGroup(cutStart, indices.length - cutStart, 2);
+  geometry.computeVertexNormals();
+  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, [material, innerMaterial, cutMaterial]);
+  mesh.castShadow = true;
+  mesh.receiveShadow = true;
+  return mesh;
+}

+function addShellCutLips(
+  shell: THREE.Mesh,
+  length: number,
+  radiusLeft: number,
+  radiusRight: number,
+  thetaStart: number,
+  thetaLength: number,
+  material: THREE.Material,
+  lipRadius = .028,

+  const makeLip = (theta: number) => {
+    const curve = new THREE.LineCurve3(
+      new THREE.Vector3(-length / 2, Math.sin(theta) * radiusLeft, Math.cos(theta) * radiusLeft),
+      new THREE.Vector3(length / 2, Math.sin(theta) * radiusRight, Math.cos(theta) * radiusRight),
+    );
+    return new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, 12, lipRadius, 8, false);
+  };
+  const merged = mergeGeometries([
+    makeLip(thetaStart),
+    makeLip(thetaStart + thetaLength),
+  ], false);
+  if (!merged) return;
+  const lips = new THREE.Mesh(merged, material);
+  lips.name = `${shell.name || 'shell'}-rounded-cut-lips`;
+  lips.castShadow = true;
+  lips.receiveShadow = true;
+  shell.add(lips);
+}
